description: Read-only stock mark refresh gate before M137 paper market-data preflight and scheduler execution.
required_behavior: Evaluate the calendar/session gate before requesting or copying market data.
When the tick is session-allowed, refresh the paper stock mark snapshot before computing the watch input signature and before running the data-quality preflight gate.
In operational mode, use read-only IBKR market data via the stock mark snapshot adapter and write refreshed paper snapshot JSON files for fill and loop marks.
If required mark refresh fails, block scheduler execution as skipped_mark_refresh_gate unless force-run is explicitly enabled.
Expose mark-refresh status in watch tick, runner, daemon, Markdown, and JSON outputs.
